name: Hanako-san
description: Hanako-san is a Japanese school ghost said to inhabit the third stall of the third-floor girls' bathroom and to answer when summoned with a specific knocking ritual. She is one of the most widely circulated school-based urban legends in modern Japan.
origin: Japan-wide schoolyard urban legend, with regional variants in nearly every prefecture. The legend has been exported through anime, manga, films, and the global creepypasta and J-horror communities.
